title: Black bounce as a quantum correction from string T-duality: Thermodynamics, energy conditions, and observational imprints from EHT
summary: Motivated by quantum gravity effects suggested by string theory, we investigate gravitational configurations sourced by an effective energy density inspired by T-duality. This density naturally introduces a minimal length scale $l_0$ that acts as an ultraviolet regulator, allowing the description of nonsingular geometries within a classical framework.
